title: Wadi El Wishwashi
overview: Discover the Enchanting Wadi El Weshwash: A Nature Lover's Dream. Embark on an unforgettable adventure to Wadi El Weshwash, a hidden gem of breathtaking landscapes, adventure, and tranquility. Perfect for nature lovers, thrill-seekers, and those in need of relaxation, this experience combines desert safari thrills, mesmerizing canyons, and the magical Wishwashy Lake, where you can swim in crystal-clear waters.
itinerary: Early Morning Pickup: Pickup from hotel in Sharm El Sheikh in A/C van to Dahab City.
Scenic Stop in Nuweiba: Capture panoramic views and switch to a 4x4 jeep.
Hiking & Exploration: Trek through the stunning canyon.
Tea by the Sea: Relax at Ras Shitan's camp with Bedouin tea.
Snorkeling & Lunch at Three Pools: Snorkel in crystal-clear waters and enjoy Bedouin lunch.
Dahab City & Shopping: Explore the promenade and bazaars.
Return to Sharm El Sheikh around 6:00 PM.
tour_include: All transfers by A/C van & jeep.
tour_exclude: Any extras not mentioned in the itinerary.

extra_info.note: The trip is not for kids till 10 years old.
extra_info.private_tours: Tailor-made private tours and packages can be arranged for larger groups upon request.

recommendations: Money for souvenirs, drinks, and rental equipment.
